summary: Wide street kerb where cars park; homes 15-22 m away and steep.

best_section.where: West kerb mid-block of Tenth Avenue, beside the pool house garden hedge

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 15-22 m away on the west side; a row of townhouses across the road; no bush or park backing.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed street with a parking lane; two cars parked along the kerb in the images.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but signs are 2P resident permit Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.

flags: Steep: about 8% at the best section, up to 21% in places
sun_shade: Hedge and garden trees along the west edge; mostly open sky, some afternoon shade from the west.
